intelligence.essence: "It's going to solve the whole 'AI is taking their jobs' thing. AI is going to create so much income for you — but the income is just going to be the byproduct of the awesomeness you experience using NayaNET." The fear is that AI replaces human value. The reframe: NayaNET amplifies human capability so dramatically that new income streams emerge as a side effect of using something wonderful. Income follows awesomeness, not the other way around. "Living without Naya will sound silly — why would you do that when you can Naya?" Rule: we never sell "AI that does your job." We build "intelligence that makes you extraordinary." The economic argument is downstream of the experience argument.
